will be null if isMoonstoneChest is true\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| initiatorEId | `PlayerId` | The id of the player who updated the chest |\n| isMoonstoneChest | `boolean` | Whether the chest is a moonstone chest |\n| x | `number \\| null` | The x coordinate of the chest |\n| y | `number \\| null` | The y coordinate of the chest |\n| z | `number \\| null` | The z coordinate of the chest |\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onChunkLoaded\nCalled when a chunk is first loaded\n\nAPI Methods that modify the chunk like setBlock cannot be used here to make\n\npersisted changes, and will introduce client-server desync most cases,\n\nbut might have some creative uses if you know what you\'re doing.\n\nFor most use cases, consider using another callback e.g. tick.\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| chunkId | `string` | The id of the chunk being loaded |\n| chunk | `LoadedChunk` | The chunk being loaded, which can be modified by this callback  * For world code callbacks this value will always be null. |\n| wasPersistedChunk | `boolean` | Whether the chunk was persisted |\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onClientOptionUpdated\nCalled when a client option is updated\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| playerId | `PlayerId` | The id of the player whose option was updated |\n| option | `ClientOption` | The option that was updated |\n| value | `any` | The new value of the option, always null for custom code |\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onClose\nCalled when the lobby is shutting down\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| serverIsShuttingDown | `boolean` | Whether the server is shutting down |\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onCreateBloxdMeshEntity\nCalled when a mesh entity is created\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| eId | `EntityId` | The id of the mesh entity |\n| type | `string` | The type of mesh entity |\n| initiatorId | `EntityId \\| null` | The id of the entity that created the mesh entity, if any |\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onEntityCollision\nCalled when a entity collides with another entity\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| eId | `EntityId` | The id of the entity |\n| otherEId | `EntityId` | The id of the other entity |\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onEntityDeleted\nCalled when any non-player entity is deleted, after any type specific callback such as "onMobDespawned".\n\nNot called when an item drop is picked up or expires, or when a throwable expires or hits something.\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| eId | `EntityId` | The id of the entity deleted |\n| entityType | `EntityType` | What the entity was: for a mob, its mob type (e.g. "Draugr Zombie"), never "mob"; "Item" for an item drop |\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onInventoryUpdated\nCalled when a player\'s inventory is updated\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| playerId | `PlayerId` | The id of the player whose inventory was updated |\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onItemDropCreated\nCalled when an item drop is created\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| itemEId | `EntityId` | The id of the item drop |\n| itemName | `string` | The name of the item dropped |\n| itemAmount | `number` | The amount dropped |\n| x | `number` | The x coordinate of the item drop |\n| y | `number` | The y coordinate of the item drop |\n| z | `number` | The z coordinate of the item drop |\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onMobDamagingOtherMob\nCalled when a mob is damaging another mob\n\nReturn "preventDamage" to prevent damage\n\nReturn number to change damage dealt to that amount\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| attackingMob | `MobId` | the id of the mob attacking |\n| damagedMob | `MobId` | the id of the mob being damaged |\n| damageDealt | `number` | the amount of damage dealt |\n| withItem | `string` | the item used to attack |\n| damageInfo | `DamageInfo` | what dealt the hit: a melee swing, an explosion, a projectile, etc. |\n\n\n### Returns:\n`number \\| void \\| "preventDamage"`\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onMobDamagingPlayer\nCalled when a mob is damaging a player\n\nReturn "preventDamage" to prevent damage\n\nReturn number to change damage dealt to that amount\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| attackingMob | `MobId` | the id of the mob damaging the player |\n| damagedPlayer | `PlayerId` | the id of the player being damaged |\n| damageDealt | `number` | the amount of damage dealt |\n| withItem | `string` | the item used to attack |\n| damageInfo | `DamageInfo` | what dealt the hit: a melee swing, an explosion, a projectile, etc. |\n\n\n### Returns:\n`number \\| void \\| "preventDamage"`\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onMobDespawned\nCalled when a mob is gone for any reason: killed, despawned by the world, or removed by code. Use it to know when mobs you spawned are dead.\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| mobId | `MobId` | The id of the mob despawned |\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onMobKilledOtherMob\nCalled when a mob kills another mob\n\nReturn "preventDrop" to prevent the mob from dropping items\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| attackingMob | `MobId` | The id of the mob attacking |\n| killedMob | `MobId` | The id of the mob killed |\n| damageDealt | `number` | The amount of damage dealt |\n| withItem | `string` | The item used to attack |\n\n\n### Returns:\n`void \\| "preventDrop"`\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onMobKilledPlayer\nCalled when a mob kills a player\n\nReturn "keepInventory" to not drop the player\'s inventory\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| attackingMob | `any` | The id of the mob attacking |\n| killedPlayer | `any` | The id of the player killed |\n| damageDealt | `any` | The amount of damage dealt |\n| withItem | `any` | The item used to attack |\n\n\n### Returns:\n`void \\| "keepInventory"`\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onMobSettingUpdated\nCalled when a mob setting is updated\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| mobId | `MobId` | The id of the mob whose setting was updated |\n| setting | `MobSetting` | The setting that was updated |\n| value | `any` | The new value of the setting |\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onPlayerAltAction\nCalled when player completes an alt action. Right click, the interact bind (E by default) and a mobile tap all arrive here; a left click does not, so this is the callback to use for anything a player should have to choose to do rather than trigger by swinging.\n\nKeeps firing while the input is held, roughly every 50-150ms. That is harmless for anything idempotent, but an interaction that grants an item, charges a currency or advances a conversation has to swallow the repeats itself - open shops with toggle off, and debounce the rest per player.\n\nThe co-ordinates will be undefined if there is no targeted block (and block will be "Air")\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| playerId | `PlayerId` | The id of the player completing the alt action |\n| x | `number` | The x coordinate of the targeted block |\n| y | `number` | The y coordinate of the targeted block |\n| z | `number` | The z coordinate of the targeted block |\n| block | `BlockName` | The name of the targeted block |\n| targetEId | `EntityId \\| null` | The id of the targeted entity |\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onPlayerAttack\nCalled when a player attacks another player\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| playerId | `string` | The id of the player attacking |\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onPlayerAttemptAltAction\nCalled when player alt actions (right click on pc).\n\nThe co-ordinates will be undefined if there is no targeted block (and block will be "Air")\n\nSome actions can be prevented by returning "preventAction",\n\nbut this may not work as well for certain actions which the game client predicts to succeed -\n\ntest it to see if it works for your use case, feel free to report any broken ones.\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| playerId | `PlayerId` | The id of the player attempting the alt action |\n| x | `number` | The x coordinate of the targeted block |\n| y | `number` | The y coordinate of the targeted block |\n| z | `number` | The z coordinate of the targeted block |\n| block | `BlockName` | The name of the targeted block |\n| targetEId | `EntityId \\| null` | The id of the targeted entity |\n\n\n### Returns:\n`void \\| "preventAction"`\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onPlayerAttemptChangeBlock\nCalled before a player changes a block.\n\nReturn "preventChange" to stop it. Then onPlayerChangeBlock will not run.\n\nGrowing EZ placements validate at request time and again at completion; keep validation free of rewards or charges.\n\nWhen placing, fromBlock is Air, or the slab a matching slab completes. When breaking, toBlock is Air.\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| playerId | `PlayerId` | The player trying to change the block |\n| x | `number` | The block\'s x coordinate |\n| y | `number` | The block\'s y coordinate |\n| z | `number` | The block\'s z coordinate |\n| fromBlock | `BlockName` | The current block |\n| toBlock | `BlockName` | The proposed block |\n| droppedItem | `BlockName \\| null` | The item that would drop |\n| fromBlockInfo | `MultiBlockInfo` | The current multiblock info |\n| toBlockInfo | `MultiBlockInfo` | The proposed multiblock info |\n\n\n### Returns:\n`void \\| "preventChange"`\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onPlayerAttemptCraft\nCalled when a player attempts to craft an item\n\nReturn "preventCraft" to prevent a craft from happening\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| playerId | `PlayerId` | The id of the player that is attempting to craft the item |\n| itemName | `string` | The name of the item that is being crafted |\n| craftingIdx | `number` | The index of the used recipe in the item\'s recipe list |\n| craftTimes | `number` | The number of times the craft recipe is used at once (e.g. shift held while crafting) |\n\n\n### Returns:\n`void \\| "preventCraft"`\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onPlayerAttemptFish\nCalled once when a fishing hook first enters water. Coordinates are the bob\'s position at water entry.\n\nReturn "preventFish" to cancel, or { caughtItemName?, biteDelayMs?, qte? } to select the fish and override the rod\'s bite delay\n\nand nine-second timed-click QTE. Default delays are Rusty 7\u20139 seconds, Sturdy 5\u20137, and Carbon/other rods 2\u20134.\n\nThe selected fish is fixed for the attempt; omitting caughtItemName uses the engine\'s default fish selection.\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| playerId | `PlayerId` |  |\n| rodName | `string` |  |\n| x | `number` |  |\n| y | `number` |  |\n| z | `number` |  |\n\n\n### Returns:\n`void \\| FishingAttemptOptions \\| "preventFish"`\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onPlayerAttemptOpenChest\nCalled when a player attempts to open a chest\n\nReturn "preventOpen" to prevent the player from opening the chest\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| playerId | `PlayerId` | The id of the player that is attempting to open the chest |\n| x | `number` | The x coordinate of the chest that the player is attempting to open |\n| y | `number` | The y coordinate of the chest that the player is attempting to open |\n| z | `number` | The z coordinate of the chest that the player is attempting to open |\n| isMoonstoneChest | `boolean` | Whether the chest is a moonstone chest |\n| isIronChest | `boolean` | Whether the chest is an iron chest |\n\n\n### Returns:\n`void \\| "preventOpen"`\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onPlayerAttemptSpawnMob\nCalled when a player attempts to spawn a mob, e.g. using a spawn orb.\n\nReturn "preventSpawn" to prevent the mob from spawning.\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| playerId | `PlayerId` | The id of the player |\n| mobType | `MobType` | The type of mob |\n| x | `number` | The potential x coordinate of the mob |\n| y | `number` | The potential y coordinate of the mob |\n| z | `number` | The potential z coordinate of the mob |\n\n\n### Returns:\n`void \\| "preventSpawn"`\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onPlayerAttemptSpawnVehicle\nCalled when a vehicle is spawned on a player\'s behalf.\n\nReturn "preventSpawn" to prevent the vehicle from spawning.\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| playerId | `PlayerId` | The id of the player |\n| vehicleType | `MeshEntityVehicleType` | The type of vehicle |\n| x | `number` | The potential x coordinate of the vehicle |\n| y | `number` | The potential y coordinate of the vehicle |\n| z | `number` | The potential z coordinate of the vehicle |\n\n\n### Returns:\n`void \\| "preventSpawn"`\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onPlayerBoughtShopItem\nCalled after a player successfully buys a shop item\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| playerId | `PlayerId` | The id of the player that bought the item |\n| categoryKey | `ShopCategoryKey` | The shop category key |\n| itemKey | `ShopItemKey` | The shop item key |\n| item | `BoughtShopItem` | The resolved shop item (with per-player overrides applied, internal properties stripped) |\n| userInput | `string` | The user input provided, if the item has a userInput config |\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onPlayerBreakMeshEntity\nCalled when a player breaks a mesh entity\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| playerId | `PlayerId` | The id of the player breaking the mesh entity |\n| entityId | `EntityId` | The id of the mesh entity being broken |\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onPlayerChangeBlock\nIn World Code, called once after all attempt callbacks allow a player block change, before the block is set.\n\nThe current block and its data are still available. Return "preventChange" to cancel the request.\n\nReturn "preventDrop" to stop the engine item drop, or [x, y, z] to set its position.\n\nDrop returns do not skip built-in validation or change notifications; any "preventDrop" takes precedence over a position.\n\nA block written here with api.setBlock is preserved, with normal drops/inventory charges unless the request is cancelled.\n\nCancellation does not undo your own script effects. Built-in change effects run after this callback.\n\nFor growing EZ placements this runs at request time only; completion validates again without repeating this callback.\n\nWriting the target yourself completes that EZ request immediately, without delayed growth or a growth refund.\n\nNative games/plugins receive uninterrupted before-commit notifications and must veto in onPlayerAttemptChangeBlock.\n\nWhen placing, fromBlock is Air, or the slab a matching slab completes. When breaking, toBlock is Air.\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| playerId | `PlayerId` | The id of the player that changed the block |\n| x | `number` | The x coordinate of the block that was changed |\n| y | `number` | The y coordinate of the block that was changed |\n| z | `number` | The z coordinate of the block that was changed |\n| fromBlock | `BlockName` | The old block that was replaced |\n| toBlock | `BlockName` | The new block that was placed |\n| droppedItem | `BlockName \\| null` | The item that was dropped |\n| fromBlockInfo | `MultiBlockInfo` | The info of the old block that was replaced |\n| toBlockInfo | `MultiBlockInfo` | The info of the new block that was placed |\n| dropsPrevented | `boolean` | Whether earlier notifications prevented drops; false during World Code validation |\n\n\n### Returns:\n`void \\| "preventChange" \\| "preventDrop" \\| [number, number, number]`\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onPlayerChat\nCalled when a player sends a chat message\n\nReturn false or null to prevent the broadcast of the message.\n\nReturn a string or CustomTextStyling to add a prefix to message.\n\nReturn for most flexibility: an object where keys are playerIds -\n\nthe value for a playerId being false means that player won\'t receive the message. Every player needs a key: one left out doesn\'t receive it either, so give the players who should see it {} (or a prefixContent).\n\nOtherwise playerId values should be an object with (optional) keys\n\nprefixContent and chatContent to modify the prefix and the chat.\n\nCustomTextStyling[] prefixContent is expected, e.g. [["prefix"]] or [[{ str: "prefix" }]]. A colour goes inside style: [[{ str: "[Red]", style: { color: "red" } }]]; any other key makes the whole return value invalid, and the message goes to everyone.\n\nWorld code is not permitted to specify chatContent, it will be ignored.\n\nA message world code sends while handling the chat that shows the player\'s name and their message, e.g. "Bob: hi" or "hi there - Bob", counts as their chat: players who ignore them don\'t get it, and others can report it. Text of two or more words and 8+ characters can sit anywhere in it; shorter text must end it, straight after the name.\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| playerId | `PlayerId` | The id of the player that sent the message |\n| chatMessage | `string` | The message that the player sent |\n| channelName | `string` | The name of the channel that the message was sent in |\n\n\n### Returns:\n`boolean \\| void \\| ChatTags \\| OnPlayerChatObjectResponse`\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onPlayerClick\nCalled when a player clicks\n\nDon\'t have important functionality depending on wasAltClick,\n\nas it\'ll always be false for touchscreen players.\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| playerId | `PlayerId` | The id of the player clicking |\n| wasAltClick | `boolean` | Whether the click was an alt click (e.g. right click |\n| x | `number` |  |\n| y | `number` |  |\n| z | `number` |  |\n| block | `BlockName` |  |\n| targetEId | `EntityId \\| null` |  |\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onPlayerClickUp\nCalled when a player releases a click (mouse-up on desktop, touch-end on mobile).\n\nFires for both primary and secondary click releases.\n\nKeep in mind wasAltClick will always be false for touchscreen players.\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| playerId | `PlayerId` | The id of the player releasing click |\n| wasAltClick | `boolean` | Whether the released click was an alt click (e.g. right click |\n| x | `number` |  |\n| y | `number` |  |\n| z | `number` |  |\n| block | `BlockName` |  |\n| targetEId | `EntityId \\| null` |  |\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onPlayerCraft\nCalled when a player crafts an item\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| playerId | `PlayerId` | The id of the player that crafted the item |\n| itemName | `string` | The name of the item that was crafted |\n| craftingIdx | `number` | The index of the used recipe in the item\'s recipe list |\n| recipe | `RecipesForItem[number]` | The recipe that was used to craft the item |\n| craftTimes | `number` | The number of times the craft recipe is used at once (e.g. shift held while crafting) |\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onPlayerDamagingMeshEntity\nCalled when a player is damaging a mesh entity\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| playerId | `PlayerId` | The id of the player damaging the mesh entity |\n| damagedId | `EntityId` | The id of the mesh entity being damaged |\n| damageDealt | `number` | The amount of damage dealt |\n| withItem | `string` | The item used to attack |\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onPlayerDamagingMob\nCalled when a player is damaging a mob\n\nReturn "preventDamage" to prevent damage\n\nReturn number to change damage dealt to that amount\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| playerId | `PlayerId` | The id of the player damaging the mob |\n| mobId | `MobId` | The id of the mob being damaged |\n| damageDealt | `number` | The amount of damage dealt |\n| withItem | `string` | The item used to attack |\n| damagerDbId | `PlayerDbId` | The database id of the player attacking |\n| damageInfo | `DamageInfo` | What dealt the hit: a melee swing, an explosion, a projectile, etc. |\n\n\n### Returns:\n`number \\| void \\| "preventDamage"`\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onPlayerDamagingOtherPlayer\nCalled when a player is damaging another player\n\nReturn "preventDamage" to prevent damage\n\nReturn number to change damage dealt to that amount\n\nSometimes the damager will have left the game (e.g. spikes placer);\n\nin this case, attackingPlayer will be the damagedPlayer,\n\nbut we pass damagerDbId for use cases where it\'s important.\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| attackingPlayer | `PlayerId` | The id of the player attacking |\n| damagedPlayer | `PlayerId` | The id of the player being damaged |\n| damageDealt | `number` | The amount of damage dealt |\n| withItem | `string` | The item used to attack |\n| bodyPartHit | `LifeformBodyPart` | The body part hit |\n| damagerDbId | `PlayerDbId` | The database id of the player attacking |\n| damageInfo | `DamageInfo` | What dealt the hit: a melee swing, an explosion, a projectile, etc. |\n\n\n### Returns:\n`number \\| void \\| "preventDamage"`\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onPlayerDropItem\nCalled when a player drops an item\n\nReturn "preventDrop" to prevent the player from dropping the item at all.\n\nReturn "allowButNoDroppedItemCreated" to allow discarding items without dropping them.\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| playerId | `PlayerId` | The id of the player that dropped the item |\n| x | `number` | The x coordinate of the item that was dropped |\n| y | `number` | The y coordinate of the item that was dropped |\n| z | `number` | The z coordinate of the item that was dropped |\n| itemName | `ItemName` | The name of the item that was dropped |\n| itemAmount | `number` | The amount of the item that was dropped |\n| fromIdx | `number` | The index of the item that was dropped from the player\'s inventory |\n\n\n### Returns:\n`void \\| "preventDrop" \\| "allowButNoDroppedItemCreated"`\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onPlayerEnteredVehicle\nCalled when a player enters a vehicle\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| playerId | `PlayerId` | The id of the player that entered the vehicle |\n| vehicleType | `MeshEntityVehicleType` | The type of the vehicle |\n| vehicleEId | `EntityId` | The id of the vehicle |\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onPlayerExitedVehicle\nCalled vehicleType | `MeshEntityVehicleType` | The type of the vehicle |\n| vehicleEId | `EntityId` | The id of the vehicle |\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onPlayerFailedFishCatch\nCalled after the fishing QTE fails or its time window expires, after removing the bob/session.\n\nCoordinates are the fishing position captured at water entry. Retracting, switching rods, dying, and leaving cancel silently.\n\ncaughtItemName is the item selected for the failed attempt; no reward is given.\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| playerId | `PlayerId` |  |\n| rodName | `string` |  |\n| x | `number` |  |\n| y | `number` |  |\n| z | `number` |  |\n| caughtItemName | `ItemName` |  |\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onPlayerFinishChargingItem\nCalled when a player finishes charging an item\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| playerId | `PlayerId` | The id of the player charging the item |\n| used | `boolean` | Whether the item was used |\n| itemName | `string` | The name of the charged item |\n| duration | `number` | The duration of the charge |\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onPlayerFinishQTE\n\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| playerId | `PlayerId` |  |\n| qteId | `QTERequestId` |  |\n| result | `boolean` |  |\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onPlayerJoin\nCalled when a player joins the lobby. A player shown an ad as they join holds their place in the lobby during it, but only joins, and is only in getPlayerIds, once it ends, unless the game turns that off (api.setJoinsWaitForAds)\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| playerId | `string` | The id of the player that joined |\n| fromGameReset | `boolean` | Whether this call is from a game reset (used by SessionBasedGame) |\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onPlayerJump\nCalled when a player jumps\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| playerId | `string` | The id of the player that jumped |\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onPlayerKilledMob\nCalled when a player kills a mob\n\nReturn "preventDrop" to prevent the mob from dropping items\n\n### persisted |\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onClientOptionUpdated\nCalled when a client option is updated\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| playerId | |\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onClose\nCalled when the lobby is shutting down\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| serverIsShuttingDown | `boolean` | Whether the server is shutting down |\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onCreateBloxdMeshEntity\nCalled when a mesh entity is created\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description created the mesh entity, if any |\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onEntityCollision\nCalled when a entity collides with another entity\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| eId | `EntityId` | The id of the entity |\n| otherEId | `EntityId` | The id of the other entity |\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onEntityDeleted\nCalled when any non-player entity is deleted, after any type specific callback such as "onMobDespawned".\n\nNot called when an item drop is picked up or expires, or when a throwable expires or hits something.\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| eId | `EntityId` | The id of the entity deleted |\n| entityType | `EntityType` | What the entity was: for a mob, its mob type (e.g. "Draugr Zombie"), never "mob"; "Item" for an item drop |\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onInventoryUpdated\nCalled when a player\'s inventory is updated\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| playerId | `PlayerId` | The id of the player whose inventory was updated |\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onItemDropCreated\nCalled when an item drop is created\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| itemEId | `EntityId` | The id of the item drop |\n| itemName | `string` | The name of the item dropped |\n| itemAmount | `number` | The amount dropped |\n| x | `number` | The x coordinate of the item drop |\n| y | `number` | The y coordinate of the item drop |\n| z | `number` | The z coordinate of the item drop |\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onMobDamagingOtherMob\nCalled when a mob is damaging another mob\n\nReturn "preventDamage" to prevent damage\n\nReturn number to change damage dealt to that amount\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| attackingMob | `MobId` | the id of the mob attacking |\n| damagedMob | `MobId` | the id of the mob being damaged |\n| damageDealt | `number` | the amount of damage dealt |\n| withItem | `string` | the item used to attack |\n| damageInfo | `DamageInfo` | what dealt the hit: a melee swing, an explosion, a projectile, etc. |\n\n\n### Returns:\n`number \\| void \\| "preventDamage"`\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onMobDamagingPlayer\nCalled when a mob is damaging a player\n\nReturn "preventDamage" to prevent damage\n\nReturn number to change damage dealt to that amount\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| attackingMob | `MobId` | the id of the mob damaging the player |\n| damagedPlayer | `PlayerId` | the id of the player being damaged |\n| damageDealt | `number` | the amount of damage dealt |\n| withItem | `string` | the item used to attack |\n| damageInfo | `DamageInfo` | what dealt the hit: a melee swing, an explosion, a projectile, etc. |\n\n\n### Returns:\n`number \\| void \\| "preventDamage"`\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onMobDespawned\nCalled when a mob is gone for any reason: killed, despawned by the world, or removed by code. Use it to know when mobs you spawned are dead.\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| mobId | `MobId` | The id of the mob despawned |\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onMobKilledOtherMob\nCalled when a mob kills another mob\n\nReturn "preventDrop" to prevent the mob from dropping items\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| attackingMob | `MobId` | The id of the mob attacking |\n| killedMob | `MobId` | The id of the mob killed |\n| damageDealt | `number` | The amount of damage dealt |\n| withItem | `string` | The item used to attack |\n\n\n### Returns:\n`void \\| "preventDrop"`\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onMobKilledPlayer\nCalled when a mob kills a player\n\nReturn "keepInventory" to not drop the player\'s inventory\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| attackingMob | `any` | The id of the mob attacking |\n| killedPlayer | `any` | The id of the player killed |\n| damageDealt | `any` | The amount of damage dealt |\n| withItem | `any` | The item used to attack |\n\n\n### Returns:\n`void \\| "keepInventory"`\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onMobSettingUpdated\nCalled when a mob setting is updated\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| mobId | `MobId` | The id of the mob whose setting was updated |\n| setting | `MobSetting` | The setting that was updated |\n| value | `any` | The new value of the setting |\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onPlayerAltAction\nCalled when player completes an alt action. Right click, the interact bind (E by default) and a mobile tap all arrive here; a left click does not, so this is the callback to use for anything a player should have to choose to do rather than trigger by swinging.\n\nKeeps firing while the input is held, roughly every 50-150ms. That is harmless for anything idempotent, but an interaction that grants an item, charges a currency or advances a conversation has to swallow the repeats itself - open shops with toggle off, and debounce the rest per player.\n\nThe co-ordinates will be undefined if there is no targeted block (and block will be "Air")\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| playerId | `PlayerId` | The id of the player completing the alt action |\n| x | `number` | The x coordinate of the targeted block |\n| y | `number` | The y coordinate of the targeted block |\n| z | `number` | The z coordinate of the targeted block |\n| block | `BlockName` | The name of the targeted block |\n| targetEId | `EntityId \\| null` | The id of the targeted entity |\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onPlayerAttack\nCalled when a player attacks another player\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| playerId | `string` | The id of the player attacking |\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onPlayerAttemptAltAction\nCalled when player alt actions (right click on pc).\n\nThe co-ordinates will be undefined if there is no targeted block (and block will be "Air")\n\nSome actions can be prevented by returning "preventAction",\n\nbut this may not work as well for certain actions which the game client predicts to succeed -\n\ntest it to see if it works for your use case, feel free to report any broken ones.\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| playerId | `PlayerId` | The id of the player attempting the alt action |\n| x | `number` | The x coordinate of the targeted block |\n| y | `number` | The y coordinate of the targeted block |\n| z | `number` | The z coordinate of the targeted block |\n| block | `BlockName` | The name of the targeted block |\n| targetEId | `EntityId \\| null` | The id of the targeted entity |\n\n\n### Returns:\n`void \\| "preventAction"`\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onPlayerAttemptChangeBlock\nCalled before a player changes a block.\n\nReturn "preventChange" to stop it. Then onPlayerChangeBlock will not run.\n\nGrowing EZ placements validate at request time and again at completion; keep validation free of rewards or charges.\n\nWhen placing, fromBlock is Air, or the slab a matching slab completes. When breaking, toBlock is Air.\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| playerId | `PlayerId` | The player trying to change the block |\n| x | `number` | The block\'s x coordinate |\n| y | `number` | The block\'s y coordinate |\n| z | `number` | The block\'s z coordinate |\n| fromBlock | `BlockName` | The current block |\n| toBlock | `BlockName` | The proposed block |\n| droppedItem | `BlockName \\| null` | The item that would drop |\n| fromBlockInfo | `MultiBlockInfo` | The current multiblock info |\n| toBlockInfo | `MultiBlockInfo` | The proposed multiblock info |\n\n\n### Returns:\n`void \\| "preventChange"`\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onPlayerAttemptCraft\nCalled when a player attempts to craft an item\n\nReturn "preventCraft" to prevent a craft from happening\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| playerId | `PlayerId` | The id of the player that is attempting to craft the item |\n| itemName | `string` | The name of the item that is being crafted |\n| craftingIdx | `number` | The index of the used recipe in the item\'s recipe list |\n| craftTimes | `number` | The number of times the craft recipe is used at once (e.g. shift held while crafting) |\n\n\n### Returns:\n`void \\| "preventCraft"`\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onPlayerAttemptFish\nCalled once when a fishing hook first enters water. Coordinates are the bob\'s position at water entry.\n\nReturn "preventFish" to cancel, or { caughtItemName?, biteDelayMs?, qte? } to select the fish and override the rod\'s bite delay\n\nand nine-second timed-click QTE. Default delays are Rusty 7\u20139 seconds, Sturdy 5\u20137, and Carbon/other rods 2\u20134.\n\nThe selected fish is fixed for the attempt; omitting caughtItemName uses the engine\'s default fish selection.\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| playerId | `PlayerId` |  |\n| rodName | `string` |  |\n| x | `number` |  |\n| y | `number` |  |\n| z | `number` |  |\n\n\n### Returns:\n`void \\| FishingAttemptOptions \\| "preventFish"`\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onPlayerAttemptOpenChest\nCalled when a player attempts to open a chest\n\nReturn "preventOpen" to prevent the player from opening the chest\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| playerId | `PlayerId` | The id of the player that is attempting to open the chest |\n| x | `number` | The x coordinate of the chest that the player is attempting to open |\n| y | `number` | The y coordinate of the chest that the player is attempting to open |\n| z | `number` | The z coordinate of the chest that the player is attempting to open |\n| isMoonstoneChest | `boolean` | Whether the chest is a moonstone chest |\n| isIronChest | `boolean` | Whether the chest is an iron chest |\n\n\n### Returns:\n`void \\| "preventOpen"`\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onPlayerAttemptSpawnMob\nCalled when a player attempts to spawn a mob, e.g. using a spawn orb.\n\nReturn "preventSpawn" to prevent the mob from spawning.\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| playerId | `PlayerId` | The id of the player |\n| mobType | `MobType` | The type of mob |\n| x | `number` | The potential x coordinate of the mob |\n| y | `number` | The potential y coordinate of the mob |\n| z | `number` | The potential z coordinate of the mob |\n\n\n### Returns:\n`void \\| "preventSpawn"`\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onPlayerAttemptSpawnVehicle\nCalled when a vehicle is spawned on a player\'s behalf.\n\nReturn "preventSpawn" to prevent the vehicle from spawning.\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| playerId | `PlayerId` | The id of the player |\n| vehicleType | `MeshEntityVehicleType` | The type of vehicle |\n| x | `number` | The potential x coordinate of the vehicle |\n| y | `number` | The potential y coordinate of the vehicle |\n| z | `number` | The potential z coordinate of the vehicle |\n\n\n### Returns:\n`void \\| "preventSpawn"`\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onPlayerBoughtShopItem\nCalled after a player successfully buys a shop item\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| playerId | `PlayerId` | The id of the player that bought the item |\n| categoryKey | `ShopCategoryKey` | The shop category key |\n| itemKey | `ShopItemKey` | The shop item key |\n| item | `BoughtShopItem` | The resolved shop item (with per-player overrides applied, internal properties stripped) |\n| userInput | `string` | The user input provided, if the item has a userInput config |\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onPlayerBreakMeshEntity\nCalled when a player breaks a mesh entity\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| playerId | `PlayerId` | The id of the player breaking the mesh entity |\n| entityId | `EntityId` | The id of the mesh entity being broken |\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onPlayerChangeBlock\nIn World Code, called once after all attempt callbacks allow a player block change, before the block is set.\n\nThe current block and its data are still available. Return "preventChange" to cancel the request.\n\nReturn "preventDrop" to stop the engine item drop, or [x, y, z] to set its position.\n\nDrop returns do not skip built-in validation or change notifications; any "preventDrop" takes precedence over a position.\n\nA block written here with api.setBlock is preserved, with normal drops/inventory charges unless the request is cancelled.\n\nCancellation does not undo your own script effects. Built-in change effects run after this callback.\n\nFor growing EZ placements this runs at request time only; completion validates again without repeating this callback.\n\nWriting the target yourself completes that EZ request immediately, without delayed growth or a growth refund.\n\nNative games/plugins receive uninterrupted before-commit notifications and must veto in onPlayerAttemptChangeBlock.\n\nWhen placing, fromBlock is Air, or the slab a matching slab completes. When breaking, toBlock is Air.\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| playerId | `PlayerId` | The id of the player that changed the block |\n| x | `number` | The x coordinate of the block that was changed |\n| y | `number` | The y coordinate of the block that was changed |\n| z | `number` | The z coordinate of the block that was changed |\n| fromBlock | `BlockName` | The old block that was replaced |\n| toBlock | `BlockName` | The new block that was placed |\n| droppedItem | `BlockName \\| null` | The item that was dropped |\n| fromBlockInfo | `MultiBlockInfo` | The info of the old block that was replaced |\n| toBlockInfo | `MultiBlockInfo` | The info of the new block that was placed |\n| dropsPrevented | `boolean` | Whether earlier notifications prevented drops; false during World Code validation |\n\n\n### Returns:\n`void \\| "preventChange" \\| "preventDrop" \\| [number, number, number]`\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onPlayerChat\nCalled when a player sends a chat message\n\nReturn false or null to prevent the broadcast of the message.\n\nReturn a string or CustomTextStyling to add a prefix to message.\n\nReturn for most flexibility: an object where keys are playerIds -\n\nthe value for a playerId being false means that player won\'t receive the message. Every player needs a key: one left out doesn\'t receive it either, so give the players who should see it {} (or a prefixContent).\n\nOtherwise playerId values should be an object with (optional) keys\n\nprefixContent and chatContent to modify the prefix and the chat.\n\nCustomTextStyling[] prefixContent is expected, e.g. [["prefix"]] or [[{ str: "prefix" }]]. A colour goes inside style: [[{ str: "[Red]", style: { color: "red" } }]]; any other key makes the whole return value invalid, and the message goes to everyone.\n\nWorld code is not permitted to specify chatContent, it will be ignored.\n\nA message world code sends while handling the chat that shows the player\'s name and their message, e.g. "Bob: hi" or "hi there - Bob", counts as their chat: players who ignore them don\'t get it, and others can report it. Text of two or more words and 8+ characters can sit anywhere in it; shorter text must end it, straight after the name.\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| playerId | `PlayerId` | The id of the player that sent the message |\n| chatMessage | `string` | The message that the player sent |\n| channelName | `string` | The name of the channel that the message was sent in |\n\n\n### Returns:\n`boolean \\| void \\| ChatTags \\| OnPlayerChatObjectResponse`\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onPlayerClick\nCalled when a player clicks\n\nDon\'t have important functionality depending on wasAltClick,\n\nas it\'ll always be false for touchscreen players.\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| playerId | `PlayerId` | The id of the player clicking |\n| wasAltClick | `boolean` | Whether the click was an alt click (e.g. right click |\n| x | `number` |  |\n| y | `number` |  |\n| z | `number` |  |\n| block | `BlockName` |  |\n| targetEId | `EntityId \\| null` |  |\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onPlayerClickUp\nCalled when a player releases a click (mouse-up on desktop, touch-end on mobile).\n\nFires for both primary and secondary click releases.\n\nKeep in mind wasAltClick will always be false for touchscreen players.\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| playerId | `PlayerId` | The id of the player releasing click |\n| wasAltClick | `boolean` | Whether the released click was an alt click (e.g. right click |\n| x | `number` |  |\n| y | `number` |  |\n| z | `number` |  |\n| block | `BlockName` |  |\n| targetEId | `EntityId \\| null` |  |\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onPlayerCraft\nCalled when a player crafts an item\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| playerId | `PlayerId` | The id of the player that crafted the item |\n| itemName | `string` | The name of the item that was crafted |\n| craftingIdx | `number` | The index of the used recipe in the item\'s recipe list |\n| recipe | `RecipesForItem[number]` | The recipe that was used to craft the item |\n| craftTimes | `number` | The number of times the craft recipe is used at once (e.g. shift held while crafting) |\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onPlayerDamagingMeshEntity\nCalled when a player is damaging a mesh entity\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| playerId | `PlayerId` | The id of the player damaging the mesh entity |\n| damagedId | `EntityId` | The id of the mesh entity being damaged |\n| damageDealt | `number` | The amount of damage dealt |\n| withItem | `string` | The item used to attack |\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onPlayerDamagingMob\nCalled when a player is damaging a mob\n\nReturn "preventDamage" to prevent damage\n\nReturn number to change damage dealt to that amount\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| playerId | `PlayerId` | The id of the player damaging the mob |\n| mobId | `MobId` | The id of the mob being damaged |\n| damageDealt | `number` | The amount of damage dealt |\n| withItem | `string` | The item used to attack |\n| damagerDbId | `PlayerDbId` | The database id of the player attacking |\n| damageInfo | `DamageInfo` | What dealt the hit: a melee swing, an explosion, a projectile, etc. |\n\n\n### Returns:\n`number \\| void \\| "preventDamage"`\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onPlayerDamagingOtherPlayer\nCalled when a player is damaging another player\n\nReturn "preventDamage" to prevent damage\n\nReturn number to change damage dealt to that amount\n\nSometimes the damager will have left the game (e.g. spikes placer);\n\nin this case, attackingPlayer will be the damagedPlayer,\n\nbut we pass damagerDbId for use cases where it\'s important.\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| attackingPlayer | `PlayerId` | The id of the player attacking |\n| damagedPlayer | `PlayerId` | The id of the player being damaged |\n| damageDealt | `number` | The amount of damage dealt |\n| withItem | `string` | The item used to attack |\n| bodyPartHit | `LifeformBodyPart` | The body part hit |\n| damagerDbId | `PlayerDbId` | The database id of the player attacking |\n| damageInfo | `DamageInfo` | What dealt the hit: a melee swing, an explosion, a projectile, etc. |\n\n\n### Returns:\n`number \\| void \\| "preventDamage"`\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onPlayerDropItem\nCalled when a player drops an item\n\nReturn "preventDrop" to prevent the player from dropping the item at all.\n\nReturn "allowButNoDroppedItemCreated" to allow discarding items without dropping them.\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| playerId | `PlayerId` | The id of the player that dropped the item |\n| x | `number` | The x coordinate of the item that was dropped |\n| y | `number` | The y coordinate of the item that was dropped |\n| z | `number` | The z coordinate of the item that was dropped |\n| itemName | `ItemName` | The name of the item that was dropped |\n| itemAmount | `number` | The amount of the item that was dropped |\n| fromIdx | `number` | The index of the item that was dropped from the player\'s inventory |\n\n\n### Returns:\n`void \\| "preventDrop" \\| "allowButNoDroppedItemCreated"`\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onPlayerEnteredVehicle\nCalled when a player enters a vehicle\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| playerId | `PlayerId` | The id of the player that entered the vehicle |\n| vehicleType | `MeshEntityVehicleType` | The type of the vehicle |\n| vehicleEId | `EntityId` | The id of the vehicle |\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onPlayerExitedVehicle\nCalled vehicleType | `MeshEntityVehicleType` | The type of the vehicle |\n| vehicleEId | `EntityId` | The id of the vehicle |\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onPlayerFailedFishCatch\nCalled after the fishing QTE fails or its time window expires, after removing the bob/session.\n\nCoordinates are the fishing position captured at water entry. Retracting, switching rods, dying, and leaving cancel silently.\n\ncaughtItemName is the item selected for the failed attempt; no reward is given.\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| playerId | `PlayerId` |  |\n| rodName | `string` |  |\n| x | `number` |  |\n| y | `number` |  |\n| z | `number` |  |\n| caughtItemName | `ItemName` |  |\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onPlayerFinishChargingItem\nCalled when a player finishes charging an item\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| playerId | `PlayerId` | The id of the player charging the item |\n| used | `boolean` | Whether the item was used |\n| itemName | `string` | The name of the charged item |\n| duration | `number` | The duration of the charge |\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onPlayerFinishQTE\n\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| playerId | `PlayerId` |  |\n| qteId | `QTERequestId` |  |\n| result | `boolean` |  |\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onPlayerJoin\nCalled when a player joins the lobby. A player shown an ad as they join holds their place in the lobby during it, but only joins, and is only in getPlayerIds, once it ends, unless the game turns that off (api.setJoinsWaitForAds)\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| playerId | `string` | The id of the player that joined |\n| fromGameReset | `boolean` | Whether this call is from a game reset (used by SessionBasedGame) |\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onPlayerJump\nCalled when a player jumps\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| playerId | `string` | The id of the player that jumped |\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onPlayerKilledMob\nCalled when a player kills a mob\n\nReturn "preventDrop" to prevent the mob from dropping items\n\n### player |\n| damageDealt | `number` | The amount of damage dealt |\n| withItem | `string` | The item used to attack |\n\n\n### Returns:\n`void \\| "preventDrop"`\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onPlayerKilledOtherPlayer\nCalled when a player kills another player\n\nReturn "keepInventory" to not drop the player\'s inventory\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| attackingPlayer | `string` | The id of the player attacking |\n| killedPlayer | `string` | The id of the player killed |\n| damageDealt | `number` | The amount of damage dealt |\n| withItem | `string` | The item used to attack |\n\n\n### Returns:\n`void \\| "keepInventory"`\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onPlayerLeave\nCalled when a player leaves the lobby\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| playerId | `string` | The id of the player that left |\n| serverIsShuttingDown | `boolean` | Whether the server is shutting down |\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onPlayerMoveInvenItem\nCalled for all types of inventory item movement.\n\nCertain methods of moving item can result in splitting a stack\n\ninto multiple slots. (e.g. shift-click).\n\ntoStartIdx and toEndIdx provide the min and max idxs moved into.\n\nReturn "preventChange" to prevent item movement.\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| playerId | `PlayerId` | The id of the player moving the item |\n| fromIdx | `number` | The index that the item is being moved from |\n| toStartIdx | `number` | The start index that the item is being moved into |\n| toEndIdx | `number` | The end index that the item is being moved into |\n| amt | `number` | The amount of the item being moved |\n\n\n### Returns:\n`void \\| "preventChange"`\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onPlayerMoveInvenItemWithAmt\nReturn "preventChange" to prevent the movement\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| playerId | `PlayerId` | The id of the player moving the item |\n| i | `number` | The index of the first slot |\n| j | `number` | The index of the second slot |\n| amt | `number` | The amount of the item being moved |\n\n\n### Returns:\n`void \\| "preventChange"`\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onPlayerMoveItemIntoIdxs\nCalled when a player moves an item into an index within a range of inventory slots\n\nReturn "preventChange" to prevent the movement\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| playerId | `PlayerId` | The id of the player moving the item |\n| start | `number` | The start index of the range |\n| end | `number` | The end index of the range |\n| moveIdx | `number` | The index of the item being moved |\n| itemAmount | `number` | The amount of the item being moved |\n\n\n### Returns:\n`void \\| "preventChange"`\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onPlayerMoveItemOutOfInventory\nCalled when a player moves an item out of their inventory\n\nReturn "preventChange" to prevent the movement\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| playerId | `PlayerId` | The id of the player moving the item |\n| itemName | `string` | The name of the item being moved |\n| itemAmount | `number` | The amount of the item being moved |\n| fromIdx | `number` | The index which the item is being moved from |\n| movementType | `string` | The type of movement that occurred |\n\n\n### Returns:\n`void \\| "preventChange"`\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onPlayerOpenedChest\nCalled when a player opens a chest\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| playerId | `PlayerId` | The id of the player that opened the chest |\n| x | `number` | The x coordinate of the chest that was opened |\n| y | `number` | The y coordinate of the chest that was opened |\n| z | `number` | The z coordinate of the chest that was opened |\n| isMoonstoneChest | `boolean` | Whether the chest is a moonstone chest |\n| isIronChest | `boolean` | Whether the chest is an iron chest |\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onPlayerPickedUpItem\nCalled when a player picks up an item\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| playerId | `PlayerId` | The id of the player that picked up the item |\n| itemName | `string` | The name of the item that was picked up |\n| itemAmount | `number` | The amount of the item that was picked up |\n| itemEntityId | `EntityId` | The entityId of the item that was picked up |\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onPlayerPlayedEmote\n/** Called after a player plays an emote from the emote wheel. */\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| playerId | `PlayerId` |  |\n| emoteId | `string` |  |\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onPlayerPotionEffect\nCalled when a player is affected by a new potion effect\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| initiatorId | `string` | The id of the player who initiated the potion effect |\n| targetId | `string` | The id of the player who has started being affected |\n| effectName | `"Damage" \\| "Speed" \\| "Damage Reduction" \\| "Invisible" \\| "Jump Boost" \\| "Knockback" \\| "Poisoned" \\| "Slowness" \\| "Weakness" \\| "Cleansed" \\| "Instant Damage" \\| "Health Regen" \\| "Healing Pulse" \\| "Instant Health" \\| "Haste" \\| "Shield" \\| "Double Jump" \\| "Heat Resistance" \\| "Thief" \\| "X-Ray Vision" \\| "Mining Yield" \\| "Brain Rot" \\| "Aura" \\| "Wall Climbing" \\| "Air Walk" \\| "Pickpocketer" \\| "Lifesteal" \\| "Bounciness" \\| "Blindness" \\| "Poopy" \\| "Glowing" \\| "Night Vision"` | The name of the potion effect |\n\n\n### Returns:\n`void \\| "preventEffect"`\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onPlayerPressedButton\nCalled when a player presses a custom button\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| playerId | `PlayerId` | The id of the player pressing the button |\n| buttonId | `string` | The id of the button pressed |\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onPlayerReleasedButton\nCalled when a player releases a custom button\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| playerId | `PlayerId` | The id of the player releasing the button |\n| buttonId | `string` | The id of the button released |\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onPlayerRequestChunk\nCalled when a player requests a chunk\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| playerId | `PlayerId` | The id of the player requesting the chunk |\n| chunkX | `number` | The x coordinate of the chunk being requested |\n| chunkY | `number` | The y coordinate of the chunk being requested |\n| chunkZ | `number` | The z coordinate of the chunk being requested |\n| chunkId | `string` | The id of the chunk being requested |\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onPlayerSelectInventorySlot\nCalled when a player selects a different inventory slot.\n\nThis will be called eventually when you have already set the slot using\n\napi.setSelectedInventorySlotI so be careful not to cause an infinite loop doing this.\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| playerId | `PlayerId` | The id of the player that selected the inventory slot |\n| slotIndex | `number` | The index of the inventory slot that was selected |\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onPlayerSpawnMob\nCalled when a mob is spawned by a player\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| playerId | `PlayerId` | The id of the player who spawned the mob |\n| mobId | `MobId` | The id of the mob |\n| mobType | `MobType` | The type of mob |\n| x | `number` | The x coordinate of the mob |\n| y | `number` | The y coordinate of the mob |\n| z | `number` | The z coordinate of the mob |\n| mobHerdId | `MobHerdId` | The herd id of the mob |\n| playSoundOnSpawn | `boolean` | Whether to play a sound on spawn |\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onPlayerSpawnVehicle\nCalled when a vehicle is spawned by a player, e.g. by placing a boat\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| playerId | `PlayerId` | The id of the player who spawned the vehicle |\n| vehicleEId | `EntityId` | The id of the vehicle |\n| vehicleType | `MeshEntityVehicleType` | The type of vehicle |\n| x | `number` | The x coordinate of the vehicle |\n| y | `number` | The y coordinate of the vehicle |\n| z | `number` | The z coordinate of the vehicle |\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onPlayerStartChargingItem\nCalled when a player starts charging an item\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| playerId | `PlayerId` | The id of the player charging the item |\n| itemName | `string` | The name of the item being charged |\n\n\n### Returns:\n`void \\| "preventCharge"`\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onPlayerSucceededFishCatch\nCalled after the fishing QTE succeeds and the bob/session have been removed.\n\nCoordinates are the fishing position captured at water entry. caughtItemName is the item selected for the attempt.\n\nReturning nothing gives one of that item, or drops it if the inventory is full.\n\nReturn "preventDrop" to suppress the default reward and award custom catches here instead.\n\nReturn "preventItemGrant" to deliver the item yourself while keeping the default catch effects.\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| playerId | `PlayerId` |  |\n| rodName | `string` |  |\n| x | `number` |  |\n| y | `number` |  |\n| z | `number` |  |\n| caughtItemName | `ItemName` |  |\n\n\n### Returns:\n`void \\| "preventDrop" \\| "preventItemGrant"`\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onPlayerSwapInvenSlots\nReturn "preventChange" to prevent the swap\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| playerId | `PlayerId` | The id of the player swapping the inventory slots |\n| i | `number` | The index of the first slot |\n| j | `number` | The index of the second slot |\n\n\n### Returns:\n`void \\| "preventChange"`\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onPlayerThrowableHitTerrain\nCalled when a player\'s thrown projectile hits the terrain\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| playerId | `PlayerId` | The id of the player that threw the throwable item |\n| throwableName | `ThrowableItem` | The name of the throwable item |\n| thrownEntityId | `EntityId` | The id of the entity which hit the terrain |\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onPlayerToggledShopMenu\nCalled when a player opens or closes the shop menu\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| playerId | `PlayerId` | The id of the player whose shop menu changed |\n| isOpen | `boolean` | Whether the shop menu is now open |\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onPlayerUsedThrowable\nCalled when a player uses a throwable item\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| playerId | `PlayerId` | The id of the player using the throwable item |\n| throwableName | `ThrowableItem` | The name of the throwable item |\n| thrownEntityId | `EntityId` | The id of the projectile created by the player |\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onRespawnRequest\nCalled when a player requests to respawn.\n\nOptionally return the respawn location. Defaults to [0, 0, 0].\n\nReturn true to handle yourself (good for async,\n\nbut be careful that the player isn\'t at the place they died,\n\nas they could pick up their old items or hit the player they were fighting).\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| playerId | `string` | The id of the player that requested to respawn |\n\n\n### Returns:\n`true \\| void \\| number[]`\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onTaskClaimed\nCalled when a player claims a task\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| playerId | `string` | The id of the player claiming the task |\n| taskId | `any` | The id of the task being claimed |\n| isPromoTask | `any` | Whether the task is a promo task |\n| claimedRewards | `any` | The rewards claimed by the player |\n\n\n### Returns:\n`any`\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onTouchscreenActionButton\nSet client option `touchscreenActionButton` to take effect\n\nCalled when a player presses the touchscreen action button\n\nCalled for both touchDown and touchUp\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| playerId | `PlayerId` | The id of the player pressing the touchscreen action button |\n| touchDown | `boolean` | Whether the touchscreen action button was pressed or released |\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onUiRequestResponded\nCalled when a player responds to a UI request.\n\n\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| playerId | `PlayerId` | The id of the player responding to the UI request. |\n| id | `UiRequestId` | The id of the UI request. |\n| response | `boolean` | The response to the UI request. |\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onVehicleDespawned\nCalled when a vehicle is despawned\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| vehicleEId | `EntityId` | The id of the vehicle despawned |\n| vehicleType | `MeshEntityVehicleType` | The type of vehicle despawned |\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onWorldAttemptChangeBlock\nCalled before the world changes a block.\n\nReturn "preventChange" to stop it. Then onWorldChangeBlock will not run.\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| x | `number` | The block\'s x coordinate |\n| y | `number` | The block\'s y coordinate |\n| z | `number` | The block\'s z coordinate |\n| fromBlock | `BlockName` | The current block |\n| toBlock | `BlockName` | The proposed block |\n| initiatorDbId | `string \\| null` | The player who caused the change, or null for game code |\n| extraInfo | `WorldBlockChangedInfo` | More information about the change |\n\n\n### Returns:\n`void \\| "preventChange"`\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onWorldAttemptDespawnMob\nCalled when the world tries to despawn a mob, e.g. one far from every player. Not called when a mob is killed: use onMobDespawned for that.\n\nReturn "preventDespawn" to prevent the mob from despawning.\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| mobId | `MobId` | The id of the mob despawned |\n\n\n### Returns:\n`void \\| "preventDespawn"`\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onWorldAttemptSpawnMob\nCalled when the world attempts to spawn a mob.\n\nReturn "preventSpawn" to prevent the mob from spawning.\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| mobType | `MobType` | The type of mob |\n| x | `number` | The potential x coordinate of the mob |\n| y | `number` | The potential y coordinate of the mob |\n| z | `number` | The potential z coordinate of the mob |\n\n\n### Returns:\n`void \\| "preventSpawn"`\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onWorldAttemptSpawnVehicle\nCalled when the world attempts to spawn a vehicle.\n\nReturn "preventSpawn" to prevent the vehicle from spawning.\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| vehicleType | `MeshEntityVehicleType` | The type of vehicle |\n| x | `number` | The potential x coordinate of the vehicle |\n| y | `number` | The potential y coordinate of the vehicle |\n| z | `number` | The potential z coordinate of the vehicle |\n\n\n### Returns:\n`void \\| "preventSpawn"`\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onWorldChangeBlock\nIn World Code, called after all attempt callbacks allow a world block change, before the block is set.\n\nRead the old block/data here; return "preventChange" to cancel the request, or "preventDrop" to stop its engine item drop.\n\nDrop prevention does not skip built-in validation or change notifications.\n\nBlocks/data written here are preserved. Cancelling the original request does not undo your script effects.\n\nNative games/plugins receive uninterrupted before-commit notifications and must veto in onWorldAttemptChangeBlock.\n\ninitiatorDbId is null for game code, such as a growing sapling.\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| x | `number` | The x coordinate of the block |\n| y | `number` | The y coordinate of the block |\n| z | `number` | The z coordinate of the block |\n| fromBlock | `BlockName` | The old block that was replaced |\n| toBlock | `BlockName` | The new block that was placed |\n| initiatorDbId | `string \\| null` | The id of the player who updated the block |\n| extraInfo | `WorldBlockChangedInfo` | Extra info about the block change |\n| dropsPrevented | `boolean` | Whether earlier notifications prevented drops; false during World Code validation |\n\n\n### Returns:\n`void \\| "preventChange" \\| "preventDrop"`\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onWorldSpawnMob\nCalled when a mob is spawned by the world\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| mobId | `MobId` | The id of the mob |\n| mobType | `MobType` | The type of mob |\n| x | `number` | The x coordinate of the mob |\n| y | `number` | The y coordinate of the mob |\n| z | `number` | The z coordinate of the mob |\n| mobHerdId | `MobHerdId` | The herd id of the mob |\n| playSoundOnSpawn | `boolean` | Whether to play a sound on spawn |\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## onWorldSpawnVehicle\nCalled when a vehicle is spawned by the world\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| vehicleEId | `EntityId` | The id of the vehicle |\n| vehicleType | `MeshEntityVehicleType` | The type of vehicle |\n| x | `number` | The x coordinate of the vehicle |\n| y | `number` | The y coordinate of the vehicle |\n| z | `number` | The z coordinate of the vehicle |\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## playerCommand\nCalled when a player sends a command\n\nReturn true when the command was handled. Return nothing for any other: any value, false too, stops the game\'s own commands (e.g. /spawn) running.\n\nA message world code sends while handling the command that ends with the player\'s name and then the command, its arguments or what follows its first argument, e.g. "[Whisper] Bob: hi" for "msg Alice hi", counts as their chat, as for onPlayerChat. So does one holding their name and, anywhere, what follows the first argument when that is two or more words and 8+ characters, e.g. "hi there - Bob".\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| playerId | `string` | The id of the player that sent the command |\n| command | `string` | The command that the player sent |\n\n\n### Returns:\n`boolean`\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n## tick\nCalled every tick, 20 times per second\n\n### Parameters:\n| Parameter | Type | Description |\n|-----------|------|-------------|\n| ms | `number` | The fixed timestep, can be used as "milliseconds since last tick" |\n\n\n\n\n\n\n',
       ⟦2-char-id⟧ = '# Client Options\n\nA player\'s "Client Options" impact what they are capable of doing in the world. For example you can give them a double jump by setting the player\'s `airJumpCount` to `1`. Alternatively their health bar can be increased by setting their `maxHealth` to `200`. These API methods allow you to modify the client options:\n\n```js\n/**\n * Modify a client option at runtime and send to the client if it changed\n *\n * @param {PlayerId} playerId\n * @param {PassedOption} option - The name of the option\n * @param {ClientOptions[PassedOption]} value - The new value of the option\n * @returns {void}\n */\nsetClientOption(playerId, option, value)\n\n/**\n * Returns the current value of a client option\n *\n * @param {PlayerId} playerId\n * @param {PassedOption} option\n * @returns {ClientOptions[PassedOption]}\n */\ngetClientOption(playerId, option)\n\n/**\n * Modify client options at runtime\n *\n * @param {PlayerId} playerId\n * @param {Partial<ClientOptions>} optionsObj - An object which contains key value pairs of new settings. E.g {canChange: true, speedMultiplier: false}\n * @returns {void}\n */\nsetClientOptions(playerId, optionsObj)\n\n/**\n * Sets a client option to its default value. This will be the value stored in your game\'s defaultClientOptions, otherwise Bloxd\'s default.\n *\n * @param {PlayerId} playerId\n * @param {ClientOption} option\n * @returns {void}\n */\nsetClientOptionToDefault(playerId, option)\n```\n\nHere is the full list of available client options:\n\n\n## airAccScale\n\n**Type:** `number`\n\n**Default:** `1`\n\nAmount of acceleration to apply to airborne players.\n\n Only change if absolutely necessary i.e. Rocket Obby uses 0.25.\n\n Players are used to the default bloxd movement behaviour and speed,\n\n and may be put off from your game if different muscle memory is required.\n\n We suggest applying speed or slowness effects instead, using api.applyEffect.\n\n \n\n\n\n## airFrictionScale\n\n**Type:** `number`\n\n**Default:** `1`\n\nAmount of friction to apply to airborne players.\n\n Only change if absolutely necessary i.e. Rocket Obby uses 0.\n\n Players are used to the default bloxd movement behaviour and speed,\n\n and may be put off from your game if different muscle memory is required.\n\n We suggest applying speed or slowness effects instead, using api.applyEffect.\n\n \n\n\n\n## airJumpCount\n\n**Type:** `number`\n\n**Default:** `0`\n\nAmount of air jumps the player has\n\n \n\n\n\n## airMomentumConservation\n\n**Type:** `boolean`\n\n**Default:** `false`\n\nWhether to allow the player to strafe and conserve momentum while airborne.\n\n Only change if absolutely necessary i.e. only Rocket Obby uses true.\n\n Players are used to the default bloxd movement behaviour and speed,\n\n and may be put off from your game if different muscle memory is required.\n\n We suggest applying speed or slowness effects instead, using api.applyEffect.\n\n \n\n\n\n## ambientLightColourOverride\n\n**Type:** `string`\n\n**Default:** `null`\n\nAmbient (absence of sky light) colour override - hex string e.g. #ffffff.\n\n \n\n\n\n## arrowPotionEffectDuration\n\n**Type:** `number`\n\n**Default:** `6000`\n\nDuration of arrow potion effects\n\n \n\n\n\n## auraPerLevel\n\n**Type:** `number`\n\n**Default:** `100`\n\nHow much Aura XP is required per level.\n\n \n\n\n\n## autoRespawn\n\n**Type:** `boolean`\n\n**Default:** `false`\n\nIf true, player will respawn automatically after secsToRespawn seconds\n\n \n\n\n\n## blockReach\n\n**Type:** `number`\n\n**Default:** `6`\n\nHow far, in blocks from the eye, the player can break, place and use blocks. 0 to 20.\n\n \n\n\n\n## bounciness\n\n**Type:** `number`\n\n**Default:** `0`\n\nHow much the player bounces off of solid blocks.\n\n A value of 1 is equivalent to every block acting as a mushroom.\n\n \n\n\n\n## bunnyhopMaxMultiplier\n\n**Type:** `number`\n\n**Default:** `1.3`\n\nMaximum multiplier for jump height when bunnyhopping\n\n \n\n\n\n## cameraPositionOffset\n\n**Type:** `[number, number, number]`\n\n**Default:** `[0, 0, 0]`\n\nOffsets the third-person camera from it\'s origin by [x, y, z] world units\n\n \n\n\n\n## cameraRoll\n\n**Type:** `number`\n\n**Default:** `0`\n\nRoll angle of the camera in radians. Useful for disorientation effects, death effects, etc.\n\n \n\n\n\n## cameraRollTransitionMs\n\n**Type:** `number`\n\n**Default:** `0`\n\nDuration in ms to animate/transition to the camera roll angle (when you change cameraRoll). 0 = instant.\n\n Useful for smooth camera roll transitions.\n\n \n\n\n\n## cameraRotationOffset\n\n**Type:** `[number, number, number]`\n\n**Default:** `[0, 0, 0]`\n\nRotates the third-person camera around it\'s origin by [x, y, z] radians\n\n \n\n\n\n## cameraTint\n\n**Type:** `[number, number, number, number]`\n\n**Default:** `null`\n\nRGBA array [r, g, b, a] for camera screen tint effect. Values fall between 0 and 1.\n\n \n\n\n\n## canAltAction\n\n**Type:** `boolean`\n\n**Default:** `true`\n\nWhether the player can use the alt action key (right click on PC)\n\n \n\n\n\n## canChange\n\n**Type:** `boolean`\n\n**Default:** `true`\n\nWhether the player can change blocks\n\n \n\n\n\n## canClimbWalls\n\n**Type:** `boolean`\n\n**Default:** `false`\n\nWhether the player can climb walls\n\n \n\n\n\n## canCraft\n\n**Type:** `boolean`\n\n**Default:** `true`\n\nWhether to allow the player to craft items\n\n useFullInventory must be true for this to work\n\n \n\n\n\n## canCrouch\n\n**Type:** `boolean`\n\n**Default:** `true`\n\nWhether the player can crouch\n\n \n\n\n\n## canCustomiseChar\n\n**Type:** `boolean`\n\n**Default:** `true`\n\nWhether the player can customise their character\n\n \n\n\n\n## canFish\n\n**Type:** `boolean`\n\n**Default:** `true`\n\nWhether to allow players to fish with the default\n\n fishing gameplay in Bloxd. Disable this if you want\n\n to write custom (non-QTE) fishing mechanics\n\n \n\n\n\n## canPickBlocks\n\n**Type:** `boolean`\n\n**Default:** `true`\n\nWhether the player can pick blocks (middle mouse click on PC), ignored if creative is false\n\n \n\n\n\n## canPickUpItems\n\n**Type:** `boolean`\n\n**Default:** `true`\n\nWhether to allow the player to pick up items\n\n \n\n\n\n## canRecordReplays\n\n**Type:** `boolean`\n\n**Default:** `true`\n\nWhen false, players can\'t record replays or save clips. Turning it off mid-game discards any recording in progress. Set it for the whole game, not per area: chunks load before players reach them, and turning it back on lets new clips include every loaded chunk.\n\n \n\n\n\n## canSeeNametagsThroughWalls\n\n**Type:** `boolean`\n\n**Default:** `true`\n\nWhether the player can see name tags through walls\n\n \n\n\n\n## cantBreakError\n\n**Type:** `string | CustomTextStyling`\n\n**Default:** `null`\n\nError message for when the player fails to break a block\n\n \n\n\n\n## cantBuildError\n\n**Type:** `string | CustomTextStyling`\n\n**Default:** `null`\n\nError message for when the player fails to place a block\n\n \n\n\n\n## cantChangeError\n\n**Type:** `string | CustomTextStyling`\n\n**Default:** `"You cannot modify this block"`\n\nError message for when the player fails to change a block\n\n \n\n\n\n## canUseZoomKey\n\n**Type:** `boolean`\n\n**Default:** `true`\n\nWhether the player can use the zoom key\n\n \n\n\n\n## chatChannels\n\n**Type:** ` { channelName: string; elementContent: string | CustomTextStyling; elementBgColor: string; }[] `\n\n**Default:** `null`\n\nAllows player to select a channel that is passed as argument to onPlayerChat. See engineGameplayTypes.ts for expected format\n\n \n\n\n\n## compassTarget\n\n**Type:** `string | number | number[]`\n\n**Default:** `[0, 0, 0]`\n\nThe target the compass will point towards\n\n \n\n\n\n## creative\n\n**Type:** `boolean`\n\n**Default:** `false`\n\nWhether the player is in creative mode\n\n \n\n\n\n## crosshairText\n\n**Type:** `string | CustomTextStyling`\n\n**Default:** `""`\n\nText to display by the crosshair\n\n \n\n\n\n## crouchingSpeed\n\n**Type:** `number`\n\n**Default:** `2`\n\nSpeed multiplier for the player when crouching.\n\n Players are used to the default bloxd movement behaviour and speed,\n\n and may be put off from your game if different muscle memory is required.\n\n We suggest applying speed or slowness effects instead, using api.applyEffect.\n\n \n\n\n\n## crouchMobDetectionRadiusMultiplier\n\n**Type:** `number`\n\n**Default:** `2`\n\nMult for the radius within which mobs can detect the player when crouching.\n\n If a player\'s mult is 2, then mobs will think they are twice as far away.\n\n \n\n\n\n## customButtons\n\n**Type:** `CustomButtonsType`\n\n**Default:** `null`\n\nCustom buttons to show in game\n\n \n\n\n\n## customVariationTitle\n\n**Type:** `string`\n\n**Default:** `""`\n\nOverridden subtitle after the game name in the top-left header.\n\n \n\n\n\n## dealingDamageDefaultMultiplier\n\n**Type:** `number`\n\n**Default:** `1`\n\nMult for when the player hits neither a leg or a head. Only applies to guns\n\n \n\n\n\n## dealingDamageHeadMultiplier\n\n**Type:** `number`\n\n**Default:** `1.75`\n\nDamage multiplier for when the player hits a head. Only applies to guns\n\n \n\n\n\n## dealingDamageLegMultiplier\n\n**Type:** `number`\n\n**Default:** `1`\n\nDamage multiplier for when the player hits a leg. Only applies to guns\n\n \n\n\n\n## dealingDamageMultiplier\n\n**Type:** `number`\n\n**Default:** `1`\n\nDamage multiplier for all types of damage\n\n \n\n\n\n## defaultBlock\n\n**Type:** `string`\n\n**Default:** `"Block of Gold"`\n\nThe default block the player can change blocks to, used if canChange is true but useInventory is false\n\n \n\n\n\n## dialogue\n\n**Type:** ` { line: DialogueText; speakerName?: string | CustomTextStyling; voice?: SpeechVoice; animateIn?: boolean; } `\n\n**Default:** `null`\n\nA line of dialogue in the panel below the crosshair, revealed word by word with a blip in its voice per syllable.\n\n Each new value is a new line, which replays its reveal; null hides the panel.\n\n A line stays up until it is replaced or hidden, so World Code can use `sayDialogue` from `@plugins/dialogue` to hide it after a while.\n\n The voice presets are "soft", "regular", "dark", "high-pitched", "gruff", "lively", "posh" and "mechanical".\n\n ```ts\n {\n     line: string | TranslatedText                 // `[[Item Name]]` shows the item\'s icon inline\n     speakerName?: string | CustomTextStyling      // Shown above the line, such as a portrait icon and a name\n     voice?: SpeechVoicePreset | SpeechSynth       // A preset such as "regular" or "soft", or every synth parameter.
